name: Nurhaci
role: Founding khan of the Later Jin dynasty
contribution: The founding khan of the Jurchen-led Later Jin dynasty.

checks.lead: Nurhaci (14 May 1559 – 30 September 1626), also known by his temple name Emperor Taizu of Qing, was the founding khan of the Jurchen-led Later Jin dynasty.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
